# statuspage_page_access_user (Data Source)

Fetches a Statuspage page access user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statuspage_page_access_user" "example" {
  page_id = "abc123def456"
  id      = "xyz789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
